events_state_change_sufficient.name: events_state_change_sufficient
events_state_change_sufficient.value: "events"."diff" IS NULL OR "events"."transition" IS NOT NULL OR NOT jsonb_exists("events"."diff", 'status')

objects_orphan_idx.name: objects_orphan_idx
objects_orphan_idx.where: "objects"."kind" = 'task' AND "objects"."status" = 'open' AND "objects"."watcher" IS NULL AND "objects"."follow_up_at" IS NULL

objects_task_facets_only.name: objects_task_facets_only
objects_task_facets_only.value: "objects"."kind" = 'task' OR ("objects"."follow_up_at" IS NULL AND "objects"."pending_question" IS NULL AND "objects"."watcher" IS NULL)

objects_mirror_facets_only.name: objects_mirror_facets_only
objects_mirror_facets_only.value: "objects"."kind" = 'mirror' OR ("objects"."mirror_kind" IS NULL AND "objects"."mirror_coords" IS NULL AND "objects"."attached_to" IS NULL)

objects_mirror_pointer.name: objects_mirror_pointer
objects_mirror_pointer.value: "objects"."kind" <> 'mirror' OR ("objects"."mirror_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."mirror_coords" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."attached_to" IS NOT NULL)

objects_mirror_stateless.name: objects_mirror_stateless
objects_mirror_stateless.value: "objects"."kind" <> 'mirror' OR ("objects"."payload" IS NULL AND "objects"."body" IS NULL)
